_comment: Land search 2026-10-15: Primeval Titan's ATTACK trigger ('whenever this creature enters OR ATTACKS, you may
search for up to two land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped') resolves at declare-attackers,
BEFORE damage (FireAttackLandSearch, both worlds), so Avenger of Zendikar's landfall counters land on the
ATTACKING Plants this combat. Board: Titan, Avenger and four 0/1 Plants, all able to attack; no land in hand
and a dead-draw library holding two Forests. Swing: Titan 6 + Avenger 5 + four Plants at 0+2 = 19, exactly
the opponent's life -- reachable ONLY if the trigger's two landfalls pump the Plants before damage (without
them it is 11). The search must also attack (PendingAttackDamage prices the pump: CountAttackLandSearchPump).

2026-10-16: Primeval Titan never searches for a basic in Landfall (USER: 'basics are a resource in the deck'), so the library holds two NONBASICS for its trigger (Radiant Fountain, Haunted Fengraf: no bounce, no crack -- exactly two landfalls, as the arithmetic above assumes).
